results.note: Thong Ta Kian (Crystal Bay / Silver Beach), Koh Samui: white sand, clear turquoise water, granite boulders and a green headland. Native 16:9. Found by a Commons search. Candidate 1 was hazy and dull. Candidate 2 (dusk view over Chaweng Bay) was usable but dark, so a bright daytime beach was preferred.
Candidate 1: the classic viewpoint shot of Koh Nang Yuan, with the white sandbar joining its islets in turquoise water. 4:3, and the subject survives a 16:9 crop.

The iconic panorama from the 350 m viewpoint on Ko Wua Talap: green limestone islands in a turquoise sea. Found by a Commons search. Preferred over the candidates: candidate 1 has small islands on the horizon under mostly sky, and candidate 2 is a close-up of the Emerald Lake lagoon.
Candidate 1: view from the Phi Phi Don viewpoint over Tonsai village and the twin bays with longtail boats, framed by palms. Candidate 2 was rejected because it is a 1280x177 panorama strip.

Candidate 2: the tall limestone rock stack off Koh Poda beach, with kayakers and the Krabi karsts behind. Candidate 1 (Poda beach with a longtail boat) was usable but mostly white sky, so the stronger subject was chosen.

Candidate 1: inside AMP, a wall of vinyl records with hi-fi amps and bottles in warm light. It is portrait and only 750 px wide, but a 16:9 centre crop (checked) keeps the records and amps. No official photos are reachable: the website is Instagram, which only gives a 100 px profile picture. The guide page also has a landscape storefront shot, but its 16:9 crop cuts off the AMP sign and it may be a Google Maps photo, so it was skipped.
Candidate 1, the official site banner (confirmed as its og:image): the cliff-top terrace at a fiery sunset over the sea, with a couple and cocktails at a table.

The jazz band playing in Bebop's new room (moved in 2026 to the 2nd floor of VELA Phuket Old Town, Yaowarat / Phang Nga Road): guitar, singer, sax, drums and a grand piano. It is the og:image of Phuket 101's Bebop page. Same source as candidate 1 (bar counter), but it shows the live music. It has a small "© Phuket 101" mark in the bottom-right corner that falls outside a 16:9 centre crop. Every photo of the new room carries that mark, and the official Facebook page only gives its profile picture without a login.

Candidate 1, the og:image of the guide page (credit "photos by Khun New" confirmed there): an aerial of the Yona floating club in Patong Bay, with its pool, daybeds, palms and upper deck. No watermark. The official site sits behind a Cloudflare check.

From the official homepage gallery: the pool with cabanas, white umbrellas and sunbeds along Bang Tao beach under a blue sky. Chosen over the og:image candidate, a blurred close-up of a lounge sofa that says less about the venue.

Candidate 1: the Baba Nest rooftop deck with striped floor cushions, surrounded by its infinity pool, with the sea and islands beyond in golden-hour light. Candidate 2 shows a different Sri Panwa pool, not Baba Nest.
